name: LDpred
model_likelihood: Additive standardized linear phenotype model with independent environmental noise
prior: iid point-normal effects: probability p of N(0,h_g^2/(M p)), otherwise zero
inference_algorithm: Approximate residualized MCMC Gibbs sampling with causal-probability shrinkage and zero jumps
estimand: Posterior mean marker weights and their genotype-weighted posterior mean phenotype
data_input: GWAS marginal effects (or signed Z/sqrt(N)) and reference-panel LD; validation genotypes for p selection
assumptions: ldpred:c06; ldpred:c07; ldpred:c09; ldpred:c15; ldpred:c16; ldpred:c17; ldpred:c18; ldpred:c27; ldpred:c51
tunable_settings: p grid selected on independent validation; LD radius approximately M/3000; iteration count; minimum zero-jump probability 0.05; h_g^2 estimated using aggregate estimator
component_claims: model_likelihood=ldpred:c05; prior=ldpred:c08; inference_algorithm=ldpred:c12; estimand=ldpred:c11; data_input=ldpred:c10; data_input=ldpred:c49

name: LDpred-inf
model_likelihood: Shared additive standardized phenotype model; regional Gaussian summary-effect approximation
prior: iid Gaussian effects N(0,h_g^2/M); all markers causal
inference_algorithm: Analytic regional inverse(M/(N h_g^2) I+D) times marginal effects
estimand: Approximate posterior mean effects and genotype-weighted phenotype prediction
data_input: GWAS marginal summary effects and regional reference LD
assumptions: ldpred:c06; ldpred:c07; ldpred:c15; ldpred:c16; ldpred:c17; ldpred:c18; ldpred:c51
tunable_settings: Regional LD-window extent; h_g^2 estimated; infinitesimal special case p=1

name: Bpred
model_likelihood: Shared additive standardized phenotype model specialized to unlinked markers
prior: iid point-normal effects with causal probability p and nonzero variance h_g^2/(M p)
inference_algorithm: Analytic univariate posterior mean using posterior probability of being causal
estimand: Posterior mean marker effects multiplied by test genotypes to predict phenotype
data_input: GWAS marginal summary effects; no LD adjustment in the unlinked-marker special case
tunable_settings: Causal fraction p; heritability h_g^2 in the model
